---
title: The command line
---

The `cli` extra installs an `alpha-led-sign` command for setting up a Sign and
checking on it without writing Python:

```sh
uv tool install "alpha-led-sign[cli] @ git+https://github.com/ellisgeek/alpha-sign-python"
# or, in a project:
pip install "alpha-led-sign[cli] @ git+https://github.com/ellisgeek/alpha-sign-python"
```

`alpha-led-sign --help` lists every command, and `alpha-led-sign <command> --help` shows
one command's options. A problem the library or the port reports, such as a bad
File Label or a Sign that doesn't answer, ends the command with an `error:` line
and exit status 1.

## Connecting

Give the port with `--port`, or set `ALPHA_SIGN_PORT` once:

```sh
export ALPHA_SIGN_PORT=/dev/tty.usbserial-1410
alpha-led-sign info
```

The other connection settings work the same way:

| Option | Variable | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `--port` | `ALPHA_SIGN_PORT` | none; required |
| `--model` | `ALPHA_SIGN_MODEL` | `4120C` |
| `--address` | `ALPHA_SIGN_ADDRESS` | `0` |
| `--baud` | `ALPHA_SIGN_BAUD` | `9600` |
| `--format` | `ALPHA_SIGN_FORMAT` | `8N1` (or `7E2`) |

The port can be any pyserial URL, such as `socket://127.0.0.1:4120` for the
emulator. At Sign Address 0, reads go to every Sign on the line, so connect
only one Sign or pass the Sign's own `--address`.

## Setting up a Sign

```sh
alpha-led-sign configure A:text:512 T:string:16 P:picture:5x4   # erases every File
alpha-led-sign clock --format 24
alpha-led-sign speaker on
alpha-led-sign sequence AB --order in-order
alpha-led-sign run-time A 08:00-17:00
alpha-led-sign run-days A weekdays
```

`configure` and `clear-memory` erase every File, so they ask first; `--yes`
skips the question. A Memory Configuration entry is `LABEL:text:SIZE`,
`LABEL:string:SIZE`, or `LABEL:picture:ROWSxCOLS`, with `:mono`, `:tri`, or
`:eight` after a picture for its colors and `:locked` to lock a TEXT or picture
File against the IR keyboard.

## Showing content

```sh
alpha-led-sign show "{color red}Hello"           # TEXT File A; --label for another
alpha-led-sign string T "72F"
alpha-led-sign picture P arrow.txt               # one row of pixel codes 0-8 per line
alpha-led-sign priority "{frame flash}EMERGENCY"
alpha-led-sign priority --clear
```

Content is [markup](03-markup.qmd).

## Reading and discovery

```sh
alpha-led-sign info                      # firmware, clock, speaker, memory, serial errors
alpha-led-sign read A                    # a TEXT File, as markup
alpha-led-sign read T --string
alpha-led-sign read P --picture
alpha-led-sign discover --max-address 15
```

`discover` waits for every address up to `--max-address`; see
[Reading back and discovery](07-reading-and-discovery.qmd).

## Sound and maintenance

```sh
alpha-led-sign beep                      # or: beep continuous
alpha-led-sign tone 100 5 --repeats 2
alpha-led-sign address 3                 # then pass --address 3
alpha-led-sign reset                     # restarts the Sign; memory is kept
alpha-led-sign clear-memory
```
